segments.contextAfter: `userInfo`: A dictionary that contains information related to the remote notification, potentially including a badge number for the app icon, an alert sound, an alert message to display to the user, a notification identifier, and custom data. The provider originates it as a JSON-defined dictionary that iOS converts to an [`NSDictionary`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/NSDictionary) object; the dictionary may contain only property-list objects plus [`NSNull`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/NSNull). For more information about the contents of the remote notification dictionary, see [`Generating a remote notification`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/UserNotifications/generating-a-remote-notification).
